item_short_desc: Rothco's Leather Clip-On Badge Holder is designed with functionality and durability in mind. Featuring a "West Coast Badge" style and a sturdy tempered steel clip, this badge holder ensures your badge stays securely in place during any activity. Measuring 3 3/4 inch x 2 5/8 inch x 1/4 inch, the clip holder is compact yet spacious enough to accommodate various badge sizes. Crafted from high-quality leather, the holder offers a professional look and long-lasting use.
